name: offline-accounting-foundation
description: Original offline-first accounting desktop, shared engine and authenticated synchronization service.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/workspace && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.worker.json
scripts.lint: eslint packages apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/test apps/desktop/vite.config.ts apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/api/prisma.config.ts apps/web/src apps/web/test --max-warnings 0
scripts.build: npm run generate --workspace @erp/api && tsc -b packages/domain packages/application packages/contracts apps/api && npm run build --workspace @erp/desktop && npm run build --workspace @erp/web
